THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
SOFT STRUCTURE
011
08 / Powder Blue
Playful Texture
A fitted pale blue cardigan and pleated skirt contrast with white
fluffy leg warmers and black loafers. Oversized hoops and a
small beaded bag give the outfit an early 2000s influence.
09 / Ochre Study
Retro Form
The ochre fitted dress uses a Mandarin-inspired collar, an oval
neckline detail, side gathering and a twisted bodice. Long copper
hair adds tonal contrast.
